official_name.value: Ramon Llull University-Blanquerna School of Communication and International Relations

min_standing_note.notes: No minimum completed-semester requirement stated in AY 2026/2027 Blanquerna FCRI Fact Sheet (Master courses closed unless holding prior bachelor's degree, p.3).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel scope is University-wide (though partner unit itself is specifically Blanquerna School of Communication & International Relations).

eligible_majors.notes: University-wide scope at AUC, hosted at Blanquerna FCRI (Communication, Journalism, Advertising/PR, Audiovisual, International Relations, Global Communication Management).

excluded_majors.notes: Students without a completed university degree cannot take Official Master courses (if eligible, max 30% of Learning Agreement); IQS Fact Sheet in Drive belongs to a separate URL school and is excluded.

min_gpa_host.notes: No numeric minimum GPA published in Blanquerna 2026/2027 Fact Sheet.

instruction_languages.notes: International Relations & Global Communication Management degrees taught ALL in English; Communication degrees mainly Catalan/Spanish with select English electives.

english_course_availability.notes: All courses in International Relations and Global Communication Management are taught in English, plus English electives in Communication.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 compulsory for any English-taught course (Cambridge First, IELTS 5-6.5, TOEFL iBT 87-109, PTE Academic 59-75, Trinity ISE II, Michigan ECCE). Exempt if studying a degree totally in English (e.g., AUC) or holding home coordinator certificate / English-waiver clause.

host_language_requirement.value: Spanish/Catalan CEFR B1 strongly recommended (no certificate upload required) for Communication courses in Spanish/Catalan; free 2-ECTS Catalan & Spanish courses provided.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Term: Mandatory Welcome Day Sep 8; Classes Sep 14 - Dec 22; Christmas Holidays Dec 23 - Jan 6; Exams Jan 7 - Jan 18; Retakes Jan 25 - Feb 4.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Term: Mandatory Welcome Day Feb 4; Classes Feb 8 - May 20; Easter Mar 22 - 29; Exams May 25 - Jun 3; Retakes Jun 14 - Jun 23.

tuition_model.notes: Tuition-waiver clause is not stated explicitly inside Blanquerna 2026/2027 Fact Sheet or verified blanquerna.edu pages.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: No monthly EUR living-cost table published in Blanquerna 2026/2027 Fact Sheet (avoiding unverified third-party/unanchored Barcelona estimates).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No Blanquerna-published local monthly living budget.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: All students must hold mandatory complementary private medical insurance (accidents, civil liability, repatriation, medical interventions; Spanish insurer strongly recommended; URL details at https://www.url.edu/en/international/asseguranca). EU citizens also need EHIC.

housing_availability.notes: Blanquerna-URL has no own accommodation, but helps students find rooms/apartments/residences with priority access via All Roomies and Ramon Llull agency partners (https://www.blanquerna.edu/en/accommodation).

housing_notes.value: Early search strongly recommended in Barcelona; priority access through All Roomies + URL residence hall agreements.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Note: FCRI Fact Sheet lists no incoming stipend for non-Erasmus bilateral exchange.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-Schengen students must apply early for a Spanish Study Visa upon acceptance; arriving with a valid visa on mandatory Welcome Day is required (see https://www.url.edu/en/international/international-students-procedure/non-eu-community-students).

course_catalog_url.notes: Provisional Fall/Spring course spreadsheets and syllabi are linked post-application (see also 2025-26 provisional course PDFs).

english_course_list_url.notes: Courses & syllabi use dynamic per-course URLs (serveis.blq.url.edu) and seasonal Google Drive provisional Excel/PDF lists linked from Fact Sheet p.5 rather than one static URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system (1 ECTS = 25 hrs total: 10 attendance + 15 independent study). Grading 0-10 (5.0 minimum pass; 1-month exam calendar notice; on-site exams).
credit_system_and_load.notes: Note: 2025-26 provisional course sheet cites min 18 / max 30 ECTS learning agreement targets; 2026-27 PDF specifies 25 hrs/ECTS and LA windows Jun 15-30 / Nov 15-30.

course_restrictions_note.value: Limited seats allocated first-come, first-served after application; Learning Agreements accepted only Jun 15-30 (Fall/AY) and Nov 15-30 (Spring); Master courses require completed degree and cap at 30% of LA; Welcome Day English placement test mandatory for ESL courses with no second call.

value: English B2 proficiency proof (or English-degree waiver)
Spanish B1 proof (recommended if taking Spanish/Catalan courses)

academic_style.value: Compulsory Welcome Day attendance; 10-point grading scale (5.0 pass) with two sittings (ordinary + retake) and mandatory on-site exams.

city_tier.notes: Located in Barcelona (Plaça Joan Coromines, s/n, 08001); Fact Sheet does not state city population tier.

campus_type.notes: City building in central Barcelona (08001), without explicit urban/campus_type classification label in Fact Sheet.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not rated in Blanquerna Fact Sheet.

international_support_services.value: Blanquerna Mobility Office, compulsory Welcome Day orientation, free 2-ECTS Catalan & Spanish courses, All Roomies housing priority, and URL insurance/visa procedure guides.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2026-2027 First Semester (Fall): Nomination May 15 (email), Online Application Jun 15. Second Semester (Spring): Nomination Oct 15, Online Application Nov 15 (strict; Learning Agreements Jun 15-30 / Nov 15-30).
